page.overview:
Who is Matthea Cathley?

Matthea "Matty" Cathley was a Twi'lek female Jedi Padawan who was the apprentice of Jedi Master Leebon. She operated out of the moon Jedha alongside Oliviah Zeveron in 382 BBY. That year, she fought in the Battle of Jedha and was essential to protecting the tapbar Enlightenment, which was harboring many people from the carnage.

Cathley had a habit of talking too much, which annoyed many but not Leebon. Her second master, Vildar Mac, was at first annoyed by her habit of speaking too much. Mac became Cathley's master after the Battle of Jedha, in which Leebon was killed by the Great Leveler.

Cathley was sent to find Vildar Mac when he arrived on Jedha, explaining to him that they would be investigating a theft before heading to the Convocation chambers. As they made their way there, Cathley also explained to Mac that people were not very friendly to Jedi on Jedha, despite their past history there. Cathley asked Mac why he chose to come here instead of heading to the front line, but interrupted the conversation by wanting to watch a performance. As an argument broke out, Cathley tried to meditate but was turned on by everyone despite stubbornly trying to help. When Mac reacted aggressively to a Sorcerer of Tund's appearance, Cathley again tried to smooth things over and the two Jedi continued onward.

Cathley once again found herself explaining to Mac, this time about the stolen item and how they had been asked to find it. Mac was not listening much and instead realized that the droid SK-0T was present there. Cathley watched in horror as Tey Sirrek, owner of the droid, stopped Mac's heart and made him seemingly dead.
